== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Reaper{{!}}The Reaper Division is a specialized group within the [[Abidan]] established to protect existence by eliminating various threats. Unlike other divisions, this unit focuses its interventions on areas where the [[Abidan]] are typically unable to operate. The division operates under the Authority{{!}}authority of Ozriel, the eighth [[Judge]], who is accountable to the [[Court]] of Seven. Despite their mission to bring light to different worlds, the division faces scrutiny from the [[Abidan]], who view them as traitors rather than a standard branch of the organization. The [[Court]] of Seven also holds a level of skepticism toward the group, with some members seeking reasons to dissolve them. In its first two years of operation, the division successfully prevented or stopped the [[destruction]] of 141 worlds. The group utilizes specialized equipment, including the [[Reaper]]'s Sword—a weapon designed for combat between Archlord{{!}}Archlords that loses durability with use—and the Reaper’s Scythe{{!}}Reaper's Scythe, which produces a colorless light capable of erasing objects. While [[Eithan]] manages his own specific team of Reaper{{!}}Reapers, the division as a whole is currently working to rebuild its own systems and facilities.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a newly formed group, the [[Reaper]] Division focuses its efforts on intervening in situations where others are unable to act. Despite being a division disdained by the [[Abidan]] of the [[Wolf Division]], the unit has already delayed or reversed the [[destruction]] of one hundred and forty-one worlds during its first two standard years of operations. Although they hold jurisdiction in [[Threshold]], the division currently hangs by a thin thread. The ultimate value of the [[Reaper]] Division remains to be established through [[Lindon]]'s victory.}}
